notes: Write-up in OEIS/A131194. Every seed's orbit merges with the main one, proved in Lean (A131194_merge: every seed a >= 100 meets the orbit of 101 under next_3; merge_general for 1 <= s <= 3). With L_j the largest prime below 10^(j+8), every orbit passes through L_j for all large j: a later prime of the same 8-digit block, else a prime of block k+1 (k not ending in 99999), else a prime of the top block 99999999 shares 3 digits. Every block contains a prime by the prime number theorem (library exists_prime_block from PNT+ prime_between). merge.py: all prime seeds < 10^4 merge. Axioms propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound. Outside Lean: none.
